listing.name: Kaleidoscope
listing.summary: Over 70 new planet textures for more variety - a planet portrait pack!
listing.aiSummary: Adds over 70 new planet textures to increase the variety of planets found in the game.

description:
Can be added to ongoing games, but is not safe to update during an ongoing game.

Manual Download

Requires

LazyLib

Requires

LunaLib

Dependencies are automatically downloaded when installing with TriOS

Older versions and changelogs

Or support me on

Ko-Fi

This mod adds over

70 new planet textures

to the game to increase the variety of planets you can find. It also adds some variations to the planet types that exist, but no new ones and no new conditions (get

Unknown Skies

for that!). Naturally comes with new planet descriptions for the more unique variants.

For instance: Desert planets will spawn as salt desert, basalt desert or brine sea planets - or as normal desert, using one of the alternate "desert" textures included in the mod. This applies to most planet types.

The mod

does not increase the amount of planets

, and does not* change any existing planets. It is purely visual.

*except for two types.

Image Examples

And more!

The original textures used can be found

here

[close]

To install the mod, simply download the .zip file from the link above, unzip it in your Starsector mods directory, and enable it in the launcher.

Can be added to ongoing games, but is not safe to remove from ongoing games.

There are currently no known compatibility issues with other mods.
